description: Read one NET service order: its state, who must act next and what, the product's gates, and the verifiable service receipt that says exactly what has and has not happened (delivered, accepted, paid, settled, ecological outcome claimed). Or pass a refusal code you were given and get its plain meaning and the next step. A dry-run order never shows a payment. Free, keyless, read-only, moves no money; it changes nothing about the order.

refusal.description: Optional: a refusal code such as insufficient_net_coverage; returns what it means and what to do.

name: net_order_status
title: Where a NET service order stands, and what a refusal means
